about.format: Each pool is a list of variant lines. A reply's next names a pool (or a special token). The engine picks ONE variant from that pool for the current speaker.
pick_rule: Keep variants whose who matches the speaker (crew or clone) or is either.
Crew only ever use tell none.
Each clone is given one tell when it spawns (garble, dance, or hat). Prefer variants with that tell. About 1 time in 6, a clone uses the slip variant instead, if the pool has one.
Prefer the mood that matches the speaker: mood over 66 is calm or silly, 35 to 66 is calm, under 35 is nervous. If nothing matches, ignore mood.
If a reply has a score, add it to a running total (used by convert_result).

tells.garble: One word at the start or end of the line is stretched with extra vowels (matches garble() in based.html).
tells.dance: The line has a little dance in *stars*, and the clone often covers it up.
tells.hat: The clone wears or fusses with a hat indoors and gets weird about it.
tells.none: No tell. All crew lines, plus slips (where the clone gives itself away with words instead).

about.red_herrings: Nervous and silly crew lines are suspicious on purpose but never use a tell. The rule for the player: weird is not the same as clone. Look for the tell.

entry_points.greet_entrance: A visitor at the front door.
entry_points.npc_question: Optional: the visitor asks you something first.

special_next.identify: Run IDENTIFY on the speaker. Clone goes to pool caught, crew goes to pool wrong_identify (and their mood drops).
special_next.admit: Let the visitor into the lobby (clone or not).
special_next.turn_away: Send the visitor away. If they were a clone, small bonus; if crew, they leave a little sad.
special_next.exile: Same as the Exile button in cloneChoice().
special_next.jail: Same as the Jail button (needs a Holding Cell).
special_next.cure: Same as the Cure button (needs a Clone Lab and 30 tech).
special_next.convert_result: Add up reply scores from convert_1 to convert_3. 3 or more goes to convert_yes, else convert_no.
